directives.title: Monitor £1.6M of current suppliers with Companies House red flags
directives.evidence: 7 current suppliers have Companies House compliance issues (historical payments were made before breaches started)
directives.notes: Historical payments pre-breach — but demand watchlist + proactive monitoring.

directives.title: Investigate £7.6M likely duplicate payments
directives.evidence: 1166 high-confidence duplicate groups with same supplier, amount, date and reference (3+ copies) (after filtering 68880 CSV republication artifacts)
directives.notes: Request duplicate payment recovery report from s151 officer.

directives.title: Scrutinise £284.8M medium-confidence duplicate payments
directives.notes: Sample audit of top 50 groups by value — different references may be legitimate.

directives.title: Challenge £88.2M suspected split payments
directives.evidence: 340 instances of 3+ payments just below approval thresholds in the same week
directives.notes: Classic indicator of bypassed procurement controls. FOI procurement authorisation records.

directives.title: FOI: round-number payments over £5K (£142.1M)
directives.evidence: 1137 exact round-number payments over £5,000 — may indicate estimates rather than invoiced amounts
directives.notes: Round figures can indicate estimates rather than invoiced amounts. FOI invoice breakdown for top 20.

directives.title: Review 15 rapid-payment suppliers (<14-day cadence)
directives.evidence: 15 suppliers receive payments every <14 days on average. Top: Vcare-24 Ltd (2.0 day avg, 24 payments, £15.9K)
directives.notes: Suggests framework contract lacking consolidation OR pass-through arrangement. Request contract register for top 5.

directives.title: Review Benford's Law first-digit distribution (χ²=168693.69)
directives.evidence: Significant deviation from Benford's Law (p < 0.001). Digit 3 deviates 19.8% from expected distribution across 331,674 transactions. Note: with 331,674 transactions, chi-squared tests are highly sensitive — the 19.8% max digit deviation is the more practical measure of anomaly.
directives.notes: Statistical noise on large samples; compare with other councils before escalating.

directives.title: Investigate Benford's 2nd-digit anomaly (χ²=8532.37)
directives.evidence: Second-digit distribution across 331,674 transactions shows p < 0.001 (highly significant). Digit 1 deviates 3.56% from Nigrini's expected distribution. Second-digit tests are more discriminating than first-digit for detecting round-number bias and fabricated invoices.
directives.notes: Second-digit tests are more discriminating than first-digit for round-number bias and fabricated invoices.

directives.title: Scrutinise 43 weak-competition contracts
directives.evidence: 43 contracts show signs of limited competition (short tender periods or rapid award). Top: Big Picture Learning - Social Impact Bond (£6.5M)
directives.notes: FOI tender evaluation reports. Question at Scrutiny why restricted tender was used.

directives.title: Request internal audit action plan on all 9 DOGE findings
directives.notes: Formal letter to Chief Internal Auditor requesting a written action plan covering all DOGE findings. Request named owners, committed timescales, and reporting back to Audit Committee.
